response.sql: WITH trader_type_counts AS (SELECT trader.tradekind, COUNT(*) as type_count FROM advancedbehavior INNER JOIN transactionrecord ON advancedbehavior.translink = transactionrecord.transreg INNER JOIN trader ON transactionrecord.trdref = trader.tradereg GROUP BY trader.tradekind), total_sum AS (SELECT SUM(type_count) as total FROM trader_type_counts), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(type_count AS REAL)) as baseline_val FROM trader_type_counts), with_metrics AS (SELECT ttc.tradekind, ttc.type_count, CAST(ttc.type_count AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM total_sum) as share, (SELECT baseline_val FROM baseline) as baseline_val FROM trader_type_counts ttc), filtered AS (SELECT * FROM with_metrics WHERE type_count > baseline_val) SELECT SUM(type_count) as sum_counts, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(CAST(type_count AS REAL) - baseline_val) as avg_count_minus_baseline FROM filtered;

assumptions.assumption: If no trader types have counts strictly greater than the baseline, the result will contain NULL values.
